native_mechanics.source: Cobblemon-fabric-1.8.0+1.21.1.jar, read 2026-10-05 with python zipfile and javap (the copy in an EXP-000 worktree runtime); NOT seen in game
native_mechanics.shearing: native for these animals. PokemonEntity implements vanilla Shearable (class_5147); in its interact the shears branch runs when the owner UUID equals the player's OR is null (an unowned Pokemon), and isShearable (method_27072) needs the species feature `sheared` off. data/cobblemon/species mareep, wooloo and dubwool declare features ["sheared"]; sheared() drops wool by the colour feature
native_mechanics.wool_regrowth: native, with the eats-grass behaviour: data/cobblemon/behaviours/pokemon/pokemon_eats_grass.json adds the task eat_grass; EatGrassTask.checkExtraStartConditions reads the `sheared` flag, and its tick (gamerule mobGriefing on; no tool or config here sets it) turns a grass block to dirt and calls method_5983, which clears `sheared`. So the flock's follower list carries cobblemon:pokemon_eats_grass (id by analogy with cobblemon:pokemon_sleeps, which lives in the same folder and was proven on staging 2026-10-03), and the pasture's top is written grass_block
native_mechanics.milking: NOT native for the farm's animals. data/cobblemon/pokemon_interactions/miltank.json (bucket -> minecraft:milk_bucket, glass bottle -> cobblemon:moomoo_milk), gogoat.json, skiddo.json and bouffalant.json (gender=female, bucket -> milk_bucket) each require variant owner_held_item; OwnerHoldsItemRequirement goes through OwnerQueryRequirement.check, which returns false when Pokemon.getOwnerEntity() is null. A player milks their OWN Miltank; the farm's unowned Miltank cannot be milked. The farmer says so (dlg_pokemon_farm_farmer)
native_mechanics.honey: vanilla, finite: the beehives are written honey_level=5, so a glass bottle takes a honey bottle from each once (no bees live in them to refill them). Cobblemon's own data/cobblemon/behaviours/pokemon/pokemon_bee.json (pollinate, path to hive, place honey in hive) exists but is NOT used: the Combee and Vespiquen are still loafers. vespiquen.json's glass-bottle interaction (18000-tick cooldown) is owner_held_item, so owner-only
native_mechanics.eggs_leather_feathers: dressing and the stand's stock only: torchic.json's brush -> feather interaction is owner_held_item; leather and beef are species drops (miltank, tauros, ponyta) that need a death the idle claim's Invulnerable and empty DeathLootTable prevent

spawn_block_reading: data/spawn_blocks.json names minecraft:wheat (the crop), pumpkin, carved_pumpkin, cake, water, every small flower, oak_leaves, sand, white_carpet, white_bed, bell and eleven coloured wools (black, blue, brown, cyan, gray, green, light_blue, light_gray, lime, orange, yellow). It does NOT name hay_block, farmland, white_wool, red_wool, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, beehive, composter, barrel, water_cauldron or powder_snow_cauldron. So the fields grow carrots, potatoes and beetroots (no wheat), the troughs are water cauldrons (no water blocks), the scarecrow's head is a jack o'lantern, and the apiary has azaleas, not flowers. No data/spawn_block_policy.json entry is needed because none of the named blocks is written; a wheat field would need one, and that is the owner's call (owner_questions)
